VBO:0200368.summary: Affectionate and intelligent in her keeper’s account, two-year-old Amy is a Cockador, also called a Spanador, a Cocker Spaniel–Labrador Retriever cross. She enjoyed retrieving, hide-and-seek and treasure hunts. Her keeper described good self-control around boundaries at home, while recall out in the field was still a work in progress.
